request.style: English, male tenor solo with warm choir, acoustic piano, cello, harp, soft strings, reverent and hopeful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mary was betrothed to Joseph
Pregnant before they came together
Through the Holy Spirit she conceived
A child of promise yet to be

Joseph was a man of righteousness
He chose to hide her from disgrace
To divorce her quietly in secret
But God had a different way

[Pre-Chorus]
An angel spoke in his dream
Joseph son of David do not be afraid
Take Mary home as your wife
For the child is from the Holy Spirit

[Chorus]
She will give birth to a son
And you are to name him Jesus
For he will save his people
From their sins this is the news

[Verse]
All this happened to fulfill
What the Lord spoke through the prophet
Behold the virgin will conceive
And give birth to a son indeed

They will call him Immanuel
Which means God with us is here
When Joseph woke from his sleep
He took her home as commanded

[Chorus]
She will give birth to a son
And you are to name him Jesus
For he will save his people
From their sins this is the news

[Chorus]
She will give birth to a son
And you are to name him Jesus
For he will save his people
From their sins this is the news

[Bridge]
God with us in the humble birth
The promise kept in the heart
Jesus the savior for all
In his love and his art

[Outro]
He will save his people
From their sins
Jesus the name we know
God with us today
